newsitem.title: USA: Amerin stockholders file for 4.3 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Amerin stockholders file for 4.3 mln shrs.

text.p: Amerin Corp said Tuesday its selling shareholders have filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 4,250,000 common shares.

Of the total, 3.4 million shares are being sold in the United States and Canada and 850,000 common shares are being offered on the international market, according to a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
The underwriters have been offered a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 637,500 additional common shares, the filing said.

The offering will be made through Morgan Stanley & Co Inc, Credit Suisse First Boston, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp and J.P. Morgan & Co. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 26,080,805 common.
Selling stockholders include the Morgan Stanley Leveraged Equity fund II, L.P. with 1,639,278 common shares being offered, First Plaza Group Trust with 565,649 common shares.
Gerald Friedman, chairman of the board and president and chief executive officer of Amerin, is offering to sell 523,015 common shares, the filing said.
The Chicago, Ill.,-based company provides mortgage insurance based on innovative approaches to sales, products, underwriting and claims processing.
